description: Use this only when the user asks to speak with an agent, get real quotes or have their coverage reviewed. Saves a referral with the business details, and the linked estimate when you pass recommendation_id, for review by a licensed agent: the BizInsured team for Ohio businesses, or a partner agent elsewhere when one is available. Returns a bizinsured.ai link where the user can choose to submit contact details. The tool does not contact anyone or request a quote, and nothing is shared with an agent until the user submits that form. Do not ask for names, emails or phone numbers in chat. Each call creates a new referral, so call it once per request.

recommendation_id.description: recommendationId from get_carrier_recommendations, when you have one

current_policy_expiration.description: When the current policy expires or renews (YYYY-MM-DD), if known. Omit dates more than 365 days past or 730 days ahead

desired_coverages.description: Every coverage the user asked for, including ones BizInsured cannot estimate

user_state.description: Two-letter code of the US state where the business operates, not the user's current location

name: connect_with_agent
title: Request a licensed agent
